# AZAFCO International - Fresh Fish Export (Egypt)

> Egyptian B2B company, founded in 2008 in Kafr El Sheikh. We farm and source fresh fish, then wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect it at our plant in Motobas, and export it whole and fresh chilled to importers, wholesalers and distributors in 7+ markets across the Middle East and beyond.

## Company information
- Name: AZAFCO International (ازافكو العالمية)
- Legal name: AZAFCO International for Investment and Development S.A.E.
- Arabic legal name: ازافكو العالمية للاستثمار والتنمية (ش.م.م)
- Legal form: Egyptian joint-stock company (S.A.E., شركة مساهمة مصرية) under Law 159/1981
- Commercial Register: No. 100776
- Industry: Fresh fish farming, sourcing, packing and export (B2B)
- Founded: 2008
- Packing capacity: up to 2,500 t/month. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave our plant.
- Location: Industrial Zone, Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
- Website: https://azafco.com.eg (Arabic: /ar, English: /en; also /es, /ru, /de, /fr)

## What we do
We farm and source fish, then wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect it at our plant in Motobas, and export it with our own refrigerated trucks, then air or road freight. Every stage is handled by AZAFCO, from the pond to the pallet, including logistics and our own cold stores. B2B only (no retail). We do not publish price lists: price, minimum quantity, delivery terms and transit time are confirmed in writing for each order.
- Packing and shipping: https://azafco.com.eg/en/processing
- Quality: https://azafco.com.eg/en/quality
- How importers order (steps, FAQ): https://azafco.com.eg/en/for-importers
- About the company (facts, milestones, the group's other businesses): https://azafco.com.eg/en/about

## Products (12 main species)
All species: https://azafco.com.eg/en/products
1. Tilapia (بلطي) - Oreochromis niloticus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/tilapia
2. Sea bass (قاروص) - Dicentrarchus labrax - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/sea-bass
3. Grey mullet (بوري) - Mugil cephalus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/mullet
4. Grass carp (حشايش) - Ctenopharyngodon idella - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/grass-carp
5. Common carp (قشرة) - Cyprinus carpio - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/common-carp
6. Catfish (قراميط) - Clarias gariepinus - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/catfish
7. Meagre (لوت) - Argyrosomus regius - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/meagre
8. Thinlip mullet (طوبار) - Chelon ramada - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/thinlip-mullet
9. Bayad catfish (بياض) - Bagrus bajad - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/bayad-catfish
10. Silver carp (سلفر) - Hypophthalmichthys molitrix - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/silver-carp
11. Mirror carp (مبروكة) - Cyprinus carpio (mirror variety) - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/mirror-carp
12. Sea bream (دنيس) - Sparus aurata - https://azafco.com.eg/en/products/sea-bream
These are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request. All are sold whole and fresh chilled, packed on ice in EPS foam boxes. Indicative weight grades are published on the species pages that have them.

## Export markets (7+)
Markets overview: https://azafco.com.eg/en/markets
- Active, with the year we started: United Arab Emirates (2008), Kuwait (2009), Bahrain (2012), Lebanon (2015), Qatar (2024), Iraq (2025), Syria (2026). Kuwait is our largest export market.
- Paused: Spain
- Planned: Europe, Russia, United States
We ship by air and road.

## Quality
We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA: ISO 9001:2015 (quality management), ISO 14001:2015 (environmental management) and ISO 45001:2018 (occupational health and safety). These certify our management systems. The export team confirms the food-safety and health documents that travel with each shipment before the order. Every order is checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed. Details: https://azafco.com.eg/en/quality
